role.documentation: Weighted average number of limited partnership units outstanding determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that limited partnership units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

role.terseLabel: Weighted average units outstanding - diluted (in shares)
role.label: Weighted Average Limited Partnership Units Outstanding, Diluted
role.documentation: Weighted average number of limited partnership units outstanding determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that limited partnership units have been outstanding to the total time in that period. Used in the calculation of diluted net income or loss per limited partnership unit.
